cells.gaps: No law is enacted. The bill's stage is unclear: the 2025 UPR report has it awaiting discussion (tabled), the September 2026 speaker gives it no stage (read as drafting), and nothing shows it advanced since. A February 2025 call for a law (GNB-005) and the September 2026 statement of absence (GNB-001) agree that none exists. Regulations and application: nothing found.
cells.note: Strongest standing stated is tabled (GNB-004, 18 Feb 2025), so stage 2; stage 3 needs an enacted law, and GNB-001 and GNB-005 confirm none exists as at 22 Sep 2026. The authority is none (GNB-002) but no cap applies below stage 4.
